items.prompt: Items 1, 2 and 3 are pushed onto an empty stack in that order, then pop is called once. Which value is returned?
items.explanation: A stack is last in, first out, so the most recently pushed item (3) is removed first.

items.prompt: What is the main difference between a stack and a queue?
items.answer: A stack is LIFO: items are added and removed at the same end (the top). A queue is FIFO: items are added at the rear and removed from the front.
items.explanation: Both are abstract data types: they specify behaviour, not how it is implemented.
